subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` hooks to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: Source inspection proves the hook gap, but the permanent hook names, payload shape, enrichment behavior, and cross-channel scope are public plugin API decisions that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
options.body: Add generic reaction add/remove hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first with docs and tests, and leave room for Slack/Matrix/WhatsApp parity.

options.title: Scope To Discord First
options.body: Approve a Discord-first hook contract now, with explicit follow-up requirements so other channel payloads do not drift permanently.

options.title: Defer Public Hook Surface
options.body: Keep reactions as system events or external workarounds until maintainers are ready to sponsor a broader plugin-event design.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
recommendation.body: Add generic reaction add/remove hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first with docs and tests, and leave room for Slack/Matrix/WhatsApp parity.

likelyOwner.reason: The most direct current-main history for the public hook contract surface points to `vincentkoc`, with Discord-specific input likely needed from adjacent channel owners.
